events.text: ROOF half DONE + verified. Root cause: the compiled loader drew every material-skinned instance as a textured BOX (world_loader.zig opaque material batch + streaming proto both hardcoded geom_key=box), so a brick-skinned gable roof became a flat brick wall (Image 5). Fix: buildMaterialBatches now partitions skinned rows per (material, shape) and a new geomForShape() helper feeds the real keyed geometry (gable-prism/cylinder8/16/sphere/ramp) to both the monolithic opaque draw AND the streaming proto, all sampling the same wmat-<i> texture. Verified via rjit game shot on map=main: shot PASS, and '11 face material(s) -> 12 batch(es)' proves the brick material split into a box batch + a gable batch. Collision is unaffected (render-only change). CYLINDER half (Image 6, beige sphere that should be a cylinder) is a SEPARATE prop-recipe issue — an unskinned part shipping shape='sphere'; needs the prop name to fix. UNCOMMITTED (shares world_loader.zig with other sessions' grass/NPC/bush + the floor work).
